# railway_service_edge_rules (Resource)

Railway service edge rules. The `rules` JSON replaces the whole ruleset of the service, and destroying the resource clears it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_service_edge_rules" "example" {
  environment_id = railway_project.example.default_environment.id
  service_id     = railway_service.example.id

  rules = jsonencode({
    version = 1
    rules = [
      {
        description = "Block known bad IP ranges"
        priority    = 10
        enabled     = true
        if          = { attr = "ipv4.src", op = "in", value = ["192.0.2.0/24"] }
        then        = { action = "block", params = { status = 403 } }
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment the edge rules belong to.
- `rules` (String) JSON ruleset, e.g. built with `jsonencode`. Rules without an `id` get one assigned by Railway, which is ignored when detecting drift.
- `service_id` (String) Identifier of the service the edge rules belong to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the edge rules, in the format `service_id:environment_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import railway_service_edge_rules.example 89fa0236-2b1b-4a8c-b12d-ae3634b30d97:d0519b29-5d12-4857-a5dd-76fa7418336c
```
